  - [`prometheus--v2.48.0:rules/recording.go?L31-L113`](/r/github.com/sg-evals/prometheus--v2.48.0/-/blob/rules/recording.go?L31-L113) — evaluates the expression, replaces the metric name with the recording name, then applies configured rule labels by overwrite.
  - [`prometheus--v2.48.0:rules/manager.go?L645-L710`](/r/github.com/sg-evals/prometheus--v2.48.0/-/blob/rules/manager.go?L645-L710) — sequentially evaluates rules, appends recording-rule output, and sends alerting-rule results.
  - [`prometheus--v2.48.0:rules/manager.go?L1128-L1187`](/r/github.com/sg-evals/prometheus--v2.48.0/-/blob/rules/manager.go?L1128-L1187) — parses rule expressions and constructs recording/alerting rules.
  - [`prometheus--v2.48.0:docs/configuration/recording_rules.md?L44-L75`](/r/github.com/sg-evals/prometheus--v2.48.0/-/blob/docs/configuration/recording_rules.md?L44-L75) and [`?L93-L109`](/r/github.com/sg-evals/prometheus--v2.48.0/-/blob/docs/configuration/recording_rules.md?L93-L109) — recording rules aggregate expressions and add/overwrite labels before storage.

Error chain: an aggregation such as `sum(...)` without `by (condition, ...)` removes `condition`; the resulting `node:ready:condition` series can collapse distinct condition states and remain `1`. `NodeNotReady` then continuously matches the critical source matcher. `DiskUsageCritical` matches the target matcher, and if the configured `equal` labels—such as `severity`—match, `hasEqual` returns the source fingerprint. Alertmanager marks the target suppressed, and `MuteStage` excludes it from notification delivery.

Remediation: preserve the intended identity in the recording rule, e.g. aggregate with `sum by (node, condition, cluster, ...) (...)` or use an explicit condition filter before aggregation. Ensure `NodeNotReady` tests the intended condition/value rather than a collapsed aggregate. Tighten inhibition with target/source matchers including alert identity, cluster, node, or service; use `equal` only for labels that genuinely define the same outage scope. Avoid a broad `source_matchers: [severity="critical"]` rule that allows unrelated critical alerts to inhibit one another.
